risk_items.finding: The canonical table changes column names; ML features reference old names through views.
risk_items.evidence: Feature definitions are not explicitly updated in the proposal.
risk_items.why_it_matters: If the compatibility view is dropped before feature code is migrated, training/serving will fail or use stale names.
risk_items.recommended_constraint: Track all ML feature references and add a task to update them before view deprecation.
risk_items.required_verification: Feature pipeline dry-run against new schema.

blind_spots: Whether any features compute labels from ohlcv columns that may change semantics.
questions: Are labels derived from adjusted vs raw prices?
recommended_task_graph_constraints: ML feature references must be enumerated before view removal.
recommended_verification_gates: Feature generation parity test with old and new schemas.
